name: 左文右圖＋兩張重疊錯位圖片
desc: 左欄是大標題、數段說明文字與按鈕；右欄是一大一小兩張直式圖片，小圖錯位壓在大圖左下角前面。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左右兩欄，內容對齊頁面內容寬度，兩欄靠上對齊：左欄約佔四成多，放大標題（可多行），大標題約佔畫面寬四成、明顯大於其他文字，下方隔一段空白放數段說明文字，最下方可放按鈕，沒有時省略。右欄約佔五成多，放一大一小兩張圖片組成一組：大圖略直式，靠右上；小圖為直式、寬約大圖的六成，放在大圖左下方，左緣超出大圖左緣，上半部壓在大圖左下角前面、下半部延伸到大圖下方，兩張圖片一高一低錯開。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：大標題、說明文字與按鈕在上，靠左；兩張圖片組在下。圖片組的重疊方向左右相反：大圖偏左、約佔畫面寬一半多；小圖在大圖右上方，上緣高於大圖、右緣超出大圖右緣，壓在大圖右上角前面。

en.name: Text left, image right + two overlapping staggered images
en.desc: The left column holds a headline, several paragraphs of description and a button; the right column holds one large and one small portrait image, the small one staggered in front of the large image's bottom-left corner.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Two columns, aligned to the page content width, top-aligned with each other: the left column takes a little over forty percent and holds a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), about forty percent of the screen width and clearly larger than the other text, followed after a gap by several paragraphs of description; optionally place a button at the bottom; omit it when there is no content. The right column takes a little over fifty percent and holds a group of two images, one large and one small: the large image is slightly portrait and sits toward the top right; the small image is portrait, about sixty percent of the large image's width, placed at the lower left of the large image, its left edge extending past the large image's left edge, its upper half in front of the large image's bottom-left corner and its lower half extending below the large image, so the two images are staggered one high and one low.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: the headline, description and button come first, aligned left; the image group comes below. The overlap of the image group is mirrored left to right: the large image sits toward the left at a little over half the screen width; the small image sits at the upper right of the large image, its top edge higher than the large image and its right edge extending past the large image's right edge, in front of the large image's top-right corner.
